newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares close up, ignore Dow, PLDT's fall.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares close up, ignore Dow, PLDT's fall.

text.p: * Most blue chips up or unchanged, PLDT down 20 pesos
An early setback to share prices caused by PLDT's fall was reversed after midsession as other blue chips pulled the index up to a higher close, brokers said.
"Most blue chips are up as foreign fund managers are starting to accumulate on these issues," said Caesar Tanquingcen, trader at Cornell Securities Inc.
The main index jumped by 29.51 points, or 0.95 percent, to close at 3,130.87 points.
Traders had earlier predicted the market would dip as the Dow shed 79 points and PLDT dropped by $1 on Tuesday.

"We have had a lot of good news, a strong GNP for instance, but the market has not reacted much. It's beginning to react now that is why it did not pay attention to the Dow's drop," said Irving Ackerman, president of Ackerman & Co Inc.
San Miguel Corp, Petron, Meralco and Metro Bank led the rise in blue chips but PLDT closed down by 20 pesos at 1,515 pesos a share.
A total of 2.2 billion pesos shares were traded. Decliners slightly outnumbered gainers 61 to 55 with 79 issues unchanged.
Brokers predicted the market would try to break through the 3,150 resistance level on Thursday.
